environment.description: Identical Kubernetes deployment with Kong API gateway in DB-less mode. The gateway has the same JWT and rate-limiting plugins PLUS a request-validator plugin configured on the /api/v1/events route. The plugin enforces a JSON Schema (draft-07) where the 'template' field has a maxLength of 0 (effectively disallowing the field) and 'additionalProperties' is false on the root object. However, the schema allows 'metadata' as an object with string values only. The Kong request-validator plugin version 1.3.x uses parameter_schema validation which runs BEFORE the request body reaches the upstream Go service. Additionally, the Kafka topic 'notifications' is configured with Confluent Schema Registry using FULL_TRANSITIVE compatibility mode and a registered Avro schema that defines 'template' as a fixed enum of three predefined safe values ('default', 'minimal', 'detailed') - any message not conforming is rejected by the serializer at produce time.
